people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

translations.web: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.
translations.bsb: When they buried Abner in Hebron, the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb, and all the people wept.
translations.kjv: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
translations.asv: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
